questions.stem: A recognized serious hazard is not addressed by a specific OSHA standard, and feasible means of abatement are available. Which enforcement theory is most directly relevant?

Treat the written safety policy as sufficient to exempt the employer from General Duty Clause exposure
No OSHA requirement can apply unless a vertical standard names the exact hazard
Defer corrective action unless a consensus-standards organization has issued an explicit requirement

questions.stem: A chemical-processing task is covered by a specific substance standard and also by generally applicable PPE requirements. How should applicability be evaluated?

Apply the specific requirements together with compatible general requirements, resolving any direct conflict in favor of the more specifically applicable provision
Apply the broad horizontal standard and set aside the substance-specific requirements
Allow the employer to choose whichever standard is less burdensome

The option 'Allow the employer to choose whichever standard is less burdensome' does not apply the controlling principle for vertical and horizontal standards to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: At a hazard-control verification, a supervisor proposes: "Treat the written safety policy as sufficient to exempt the employer from General Duty Clause exposure". The underlying case is: A recognized serious hazard is not addressed by a specific OSHA standard, and feasible means of abatement are available. Which enforcement theory is most directly relevant? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: The General Duty Clause may apply if recognition, exposure, serious harm, and feasible abatement can be established
No OSHA requirement can apply unless a vertical standard names the exact hazard
Defer corrective action unless a consensus-standards organization has issued an explicit requirement
Treat the written safety policy as sufficient to exempt the employer from General Duty Clause exposure
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: The General Duty Clause can address recognized serious hazards not covered by a specific standard when the required elements and feasible abatement are established.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'No OSHA requirement can apply unless a vertical standard names the exact hazard' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling general duty clause application principle.

The proposed response 'Defer corrective action unless a consensus-standards organization has issued an explicit requirement' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling general duty clause application principle.

The proposed response 'Treat the written safety policy as sufficient to exempt the employer from General Duty Clause exposure' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling general duty clause application principle.

questions.stem: At a federal OSHA compliance audit, a supervisor proposes: "Apply both standards literally even when their provisions directly conflict". The underlying case is: A chemical-processing task is covered by a specific substance standard and also by generally applicable PPE requirements. How should applicability be evaluated? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Allow the employer to choose whichever standard is less burdensome
Apply the specific requirements together with compatible general requirements, resolving any direct conflict in favor of the more specifically applicable provision
Apply the broad horizontal standard and set aside the substance-specific requirements
Apply both standards literally even when their provisions directly conflict
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Specific and general standards can both apply. Where a true conflict exists, the specifically applicable provision generally governs the same condition.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Allow the employer to choose whichever standard is less burdensome' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling vertical and horizontal standards principle.

The proposed response 'Apply the broad horizontal standard and set aside the substance-specific requirements' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling vertical and horizontal standards principle.
The proposed response 'Apply both standards literally even when their provisions directly conflict' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling vertical and horizontal standards principle.

questions.stem: At an opening conference preparation, a supervisor proposes: "Refuse all access until OSHA provides advance written notice". The underlying case is: OSHA arrives for an inspection and presents credentials. The site manager wants to begin immediately without clarifying scope or representatives. What should the safety professional recommend? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Refuse all access until OSHA provides advance written notice
Destroy draft documents that were not specifically requested before the walkaround
Participate cooperatively while using the opening conference to clarify scope, purpose, records, route, and authorized representatives
Begin an unrestricted site tour before identifying the inspection basis
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: The opening conference is used to establish the inspection basis and logistics while preserving lawful rights and cooperation. Obstruction or record alteration is inappropriate.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Refuse all access until OSHA provides advance written notice' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling inspection opening conference principle.
The proposed response 'Destroy draft documents that were not specifically requested before the walkaround' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling inspection opening conference principle.
The proposed response 'Begin an unrestricted site tour before identifying the inspection basis' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling inspection opening conference principle.

questions.stem: At an abatement planning meeting, a supervisor proposes: "Permit participation only if the representative signs away all employee rights". The underlying case is: During an OSHA walkaround, employees request a representative who can aid the inspection. What is the most defensible response? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Cancel the inspection whenever confidential processes are present
Permit participation only if the representative signs away all employee rights
Exclude every employee representative because only management may accompany OSHA
Allow participation consistent with the Act and inspection rules while managing legitimate safety, security, and trade-secret controls
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Employee representation is part of the inspection framework. Legitimate confidentiality and safety concerns should be managed, not used to eliminate participation.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Cancel the inspection whenever confidential processes are present' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling employee representative participation principle.

The proposed response 'Permit participation only if the representative signs away all employee rights' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling employee representative participation principle.

The proposed response 'Exclude every employee representative because only management may accompany OSHA' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling employee representative participation principle.

questions.stem: At a complaint-response review, a supervisor proposes: "Verification is unnecessary for any correction involving engineering controls". The underlying case is: A citation requires abatement of a machine hazard. The company purchases a guard but leaves it in storage while production continues. What is the central compliance problem? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Purchasing equipment does not constitute abatement until the hazard is actually corrected and required verification is completed
Verification is unnecessary for any correction involving engineering controls
The citation is automatically withdrawn once management states its intent to comply
Abatement is complete when a purchase order is approved by finance
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Abatement requires implemented correction of the cited condition, supported by any required documentation or certification; intent or procurement alone is insufficient.

The proposed response 'The citation is automatically withdrawn once management states its intent to comply' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling abatement verification principle.
The proposed response 'Abatement is complete when a purchase order is approved by finance' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling abatement verification principle.

questions.stem: At a multiemployer inspection, a supervisor proposes: "Cite only the employer whose employee is injured, regardless of control or creation". The underlying case is: At a construction project, one employer creates a fall hazard, another controls the site, and a third employer’s workers are exposed. Which analysis is most appropriate? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Treat subcontractors as exempt whenever they did not create the hazard
Evaluate each employer’s creating, controlling, correcting, or exposing role and whether it met the duties associated with that role
Assume the general contractor is the sole responsible employer in every case
Cite only the employer whose employee is injured, regardless of control or creation
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Federal OSHA’s multiemployer policy evaluates employer roles and their respective reasonable-care obligations rather than assigning responsibility solely by injury or contract title.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Treat subcontractors as exempt whenever they did not create the hazard' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling multiemployer worksite roles principle.
The proposed response 'Assume the general contractor is the sole responsible employer in every case' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling multiemployer worksite roles principle.
The proposed response 'Cite only the employer whose employee is injured, regardless of control or creation' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling multiemployer worksite roles principle.

questions.stem: At a standard-applicability analysis, a supervisor proposes: "Reduce the employee’s hours without documenting the reason". The underlying case is: A supervisor proposes disciplining an employee for contacting OSHA after the employee’s internal concern was not corrected. What should the safety professional advise? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Reduce the employee’s hours without documenting the reason
Require future complaints to be waived as a condition of continued employment
Stop retaliatory action and address the hazard through a neutral process that protects the employee’s right to raise safety concerns
Proceed with discipline if the employee did not first obtain management permission
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Employees have protected rights to raise safety concerns and contact OSHA. Adverse action motivated by protected activity can create retaliation exposure.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Reduce the employee’s hours without documenting the reason' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling employee complaint and retaliation principle.
The proposed response 'Require future complaints to be waived as a condition of continued employment' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling employee complaint and retaliation principle.

The proposed response 'Proceed with discipline if the employee did not first obtain management permission' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling employee complaint and retaliation principle.

questions.stem: At a citation contest decision, a supervisor proposes: "Ask employees to sign acknowledgments accepting the alternative protection level". The underlying case is: An employer cannot comply with the literal method in a standard but has developed a different method that it believes provides equivalent protection. What is the best next step? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: Use the alternative immediately because internal engineering approval replaces a variance
Ignore the standard whenever a consensus standard supports a different method
Ask employees to sign acknowledgments accepting the alternative protection level
Use the applicable variance process and demonstrate the required level of employee protection before relying on the alternative
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: An employer generally cannot unilaterally substitute a conflicting method; the appropriate variance mechanism and required showing must be used.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'Use the alternative immediately because internal engineering approval replaces a variance' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling variance versus alternative method principle.
The proposed response 'Ignore the standard whenever a consensus standard supports a different method' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling variance versus alternative method principle.
The proposed response 'Ask employees to sign acknowledgments accepting the alternative protection level' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling variance versus alternative method principle.
